profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer I at Raytheon
profile.summary:
Areas of focus:
- C++ design and development on Linux and Windows
- Interfacing with HW/FW over PCI bus, Ethernet, and USB
- RF manipulation through software-controlled attenuators, vector modulators, and switches
- Lab integration and problem solving through use of RDMs, plots, register data, and log files
- SWCM tools including Git, Azure DevOps, and Change Synergy
- Occasional bash, csh, and perl scripting

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Currently working with multiple software codebases that communicate with each other and command hardware in real time. I'm often tasked with adding and improving software interfaces for new hardware, designing and implementing streamlined changes for the software architecture, and updating complex geometric algorithms.

Wrote and managed a nightly cron script (csh and bash, perl) to pull in code changes, build the software, and run tests on the baseline. Often lead review meetings and design presentations. Currently holding an active DoD security clearance.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on communications systems for software-defined radios.

Main responsibilities included developing code and managing documentation (SDD, SRS, etc.).
Integration experiences and responsibilities include preparing software builds, testing on hardware, finding root cause, and implementing solutions.
Occasionally tasked with improving in-house tools and software programs.

Technologies used include C++, GitHub, Atlassian tool suite, Visio, Visual Studio, ClearCase/Quest, Beyond Compare, adaMULTI, and many in-house tools.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on a military satellite communication system.

Main responsibilities included solving software problem reports and writing unit tests. Also wrote scripts in Perl for on-orbit data parsing and analysis.

Started working on a part-time side project that used SIMICS to emulate payload hardware using software models in order to improve testing capabilities for the project.

Technologies used daily include C++, Unix, Understand, VNC, Reflection, and Beyond Compare.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: Supervised several computer labs, answered questions and provided assistance

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: All-day camp instructor, in charge of a class of 8 kids, aged 8-12. Taught LEGO Mindstorms robotics and programming, supervised lunch, and helped lead game time.

positions.title: Swim Instructor
positions.description: Taught children’s swim lessons, CPR and lifeguard certified

projects.title: OnBoard Recruiting Application
projects.description: Designed a web application for companies to manage applicants through a customizable hiring process, complete with a recruiter dashboard that shows relevant updates and automatically generated emails between stages of the hiring process. Uses a RoR framework with a Postgresql backend, deployed on the cloud using Heroku.
